title: Cedarwood Elementary open house guide
brief: Write the open house guide for families at Cedarwood Elementary, from the principal, Dr. Leonie Osei. Headings: "When and where", "Schedule", "What to bring", "Getting here" and "Questions". When and where: Thursday 2026-11-12 from 17:30 to 19:30 in the main building at 410 Elm Street. Schedule: 17:30 welcome from the principal in the gym; 17:50 classroom tours in groups of 8 families, each about 30 minutes; 18:30 kindergarten information session in the library; 18:45 after-school program table in the cafeteria; 19:15 closing words. What to bring, for families planning to register for 2027-28 kindergarten: a birth certificate, proof of address and immunization records; registration opens on 2027-01-12. Getting here: free parking in the Elm Street lot, 60 spaces, and a free shuttle every 10 minutes from the Pine Street church lot; childcare for siblings is offered in the music room. Questions: call 555-0166 or write to office@cedarwood.example. Warm and welcoming, short sentences.

edit.request: Move the open house to 2026-11-19 and start the classroom tours at 17:45 instead of 17:50.
